reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate

lincoln_pending.title: Lincoln Way Login Pending
lincoln_pending.description:
Selected: {brand}. Lincoln Way shares the same cloud crypto stack as FordPass (reverse-verified libwbsk_crypto_tool.so binds Lincoln package names), but its B2C login page, SMS endpoint and app fingerprint are not yet captured — login is not available yet.

To enable: capture the Lincoln Way app login flow (HAR) in an emulator, then the B2C tenant / SMS endpoint / application-id can be added in a future release. Click submit to re-choose a brand.

error.bad_phone: Please enter a valid 11-digit phone number
error.bad_username: Please enter a valid 11-digit phone number (username)
error.passcode_failed: Failed to send the verification code. Check that the phone number is registered with FordPass China, or retry later (see log)
error.missing_deps: Missing dependencies (unicorn or pyelftools). Confirm they were installed automatically, or run pip install unicorn pyelftools on the HA host and restart
error.login_failed: Login failed. Check that the verification code is correct (see log)
error.password_login_failed: Login failed: the Ford login page is protected by Tencent EdgeOne which currently blocks plain HTTP clients. Use SMS code login or retry later (see log)
error.unknown: Unknown error. Check the fordpass_cn entries in the Home Assistant log
error.bad_code: Invalid or expired authorization code. Please log in again in the browser and copy a fresh code.

abort.already_configured: This phone number is already configured for this brand
abort.reauth_phone_mismatch: The logged-in account differs from the original phone number. Please remove and reconfigure the integration.
